_comment: Audit rows A-AC: title and `reviewed` date (the date the row's verdict was last re-checked; bump it after a re-review). Which files each row watches is NOT listed here: it is the `watch` column of algorithm_inventory.csv (the single source of truth for which algorithms EDI implements and where). `exempt` maps a repo-relative path or glob to the reason it needs no inventory entry (it makes no algorithmic choice). See new_feature_plans/v1_0_5/algorithm_audit_runbook.md.
